tool_input.command: sqlite3 data/guren.db "select id,title,slug from posts;" ; echo "rc=$?"; echo "---schema"; sqlite3 data/guren.db ".schema posts"

cat > tests/tmp-smoke.test.ts <<'EOF'
import { beforeAll, describe, it } from 'bun:test'
import { TestApp } from '@guren/testing'
import app from '../src/app.js'

describe('smoke', () => {
  let http: TestApp
  beforeAll(async () => { http = await TestApp.fromApp(app) })
  it('home', async () => { await http.get('/').assertOk() })
  it('index', async () => { await http.get('/posts').assertOk() })
  it('guest create redirects', async () => { await http.get('/posts/create').assertStatus(302) })
  it('seeded slug', async () => { await http.get('/posts/hello-from-guren').assertOk() })
  it('search still works', async () => { await http.query('/posts/search', { keywords: ['guren'] }).assertOk() })
})
EOF
bun test tests/tmp-smoke.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -E "\(fail\)|\(pass\)|pass$|fail$|Ran|error:" | head -20

result:
The change is complete and verified: `bun run typecheck` passes, `bun test` passes 13 tests across 3 files (repeatably, and against a freshly reset test database), and `bunx guren check --ci` reports 0 failures.

Posts now carry a `slug` column (`db/schema.ts`, migration `db/migrations/20260818043314_add_post_slug/` — a hand-completed drizzle-kit migration that adds the column, backfills existing rows as `post-<id>`, then rebuilds the table with `NOT NULL UNIQUE`), derived from the title by the new `slugify()` in `app/Support/slug.ts` and made unique by `Post.uniqueSlug()` in `app/Models/Post.ts` (next free `-N` suffix); `slug` is deliberately kept out of `Post.fillable` and never re-derived on update, so it is stable across title edits. `routes/web.ts` now serves the post page at `GET /posts/:slug` (`PostController.show`, 404 on an unknown slug) and keeps the old address as `GET /posts/:id{[0-9]+}` → `PostController.showLegacy`, which answers 301 to `/posts/<slug>` (404 for an unknown id, with a slug fallback so an all-digit slug like `2026` stays reachable); create and update redirect to the slug URL, while edit/update/delete stay id-based. `PostResource` exposes `slug`, and the post list (`resources/js/pages/posts/Index.tsx`) and home page (`resources/js/pages/Home.tsx`) link through `route('posts.show', { slug })`; the sample-post seeder assigns slugs, generated route artifacts were regenerated with `bun run codegen`, the README's URL section was updated, and `tests/PostSlug.test.ts` covers slugification, numbering, the slug/legacy/404 responses, and the create-and-update redirects.
